mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and falls below 4.0% within 3 months, it signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE falls below 4.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% and then drops below 4.0% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and consumer spending (RSAFS > 450000) indicate robust demand expansion that elevates corporate revenue expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST exceeds 1500 and RSAFS exceeds 450000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 for 2 consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO remains below 100.0 for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a Federal Funds Rate decline below 0.5% triggers policy stabilization that reduces equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS > 150000) over 6 months indicates labor market strength that raises household income and consumption, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 1% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate above 19000 (GDPC1) combined with housing starts above 1500 (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic expansion that accelerates corporate earnings forecasts, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 exceeds 19000 and HOUST exceeds 1500.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% and the Federal Funds Rate remains below 0.5%, it signals a policy response that stabilizes growth expectations, causing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.
